name: Niyenin
description: Niyenin is a multi-vendor retail marketplace — sellers open their own stores, list products and fulfil orders, while shoppers buy from many vendors in one cart.
detail: Built as the retail-market monorepo. Vendors register and manage their own catalogues; the admin layer handles vendor approval, commissions, payouts and reporting. Customers shop across vendors in a single checkout flow. Stack is TypeScript on the frontend with an Express API — deployed preview at niyenin-frontend.vercel.app.
